note: Hampton County, SC publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its Resources page links only a pictorial (image) view of the county zoning map. The county's ArcGIS Online org (hamptoncountysc.maps.arcgis.com) holds a parcel viewer with parcels, roads, FIRM and base data, but no zoning layer. Towns: Hampton publishes a 2010 zoning ordinance PDF and a 2003 zoning map PDF; Yemassee publishes a zoning map PDF; no ArcGIS zoning layer found for Estill or Varnville.
